summary: Analyze deployment impact from git changes
description: Maps git changes to Salesforce metadata components, expands transitive dependents, reports planned deployment waves, and suggests Apex tests for CI decisions.
flags.source-path.description: Path to the Salesforce source directory used to build the dependency graph and deployment waves.
flags.base.summary: Base git ref for impact analysis
flags.base.description: Git ref at the start of the comparison range. Must be provided with --head.
flags.head.summary: Head git ref for impact analysis
flags.head.description: Git ref at the end of the comparison range. Must be provided with --base.
flags.working-tree.description: Uses git status to include staged, unstaged, and untracked working-tree changes. This is the default when --base and --head are omitted.
flags.max-depth.description: Limits transitive dependent traversal. Omit for unlimited depth.
